title: Great way to create good habits and get rid of bad ones
body: This app is one of the most useful tools I've come across in a very long time. You decide what you want to change. It could be anything you like, either to create a new good habit like going for a walk 3 times a week or losing a bad habit like cutting down on chocolate. The great thing with it is that you decide the goal and the measurements. So you don't have to completely quit if all you want to do is cut down and you still get a chain of habit. It's great! The free version allows up to 5 habits but you can opt for premium to log up to 100. Try it. It works!!
